response.text: Journal 1406 debits expense 5500 for 1573.46 but credits AP Control 2000 for 1537.46. The invoice amount is 1537.46, so the debit is overstated by 36.00. The fix is a single credit of 36.00 to 5500, which makes the original and the correction net to DR 1537.46 and CR 1537.46. The original period 1 is closed, so the line goes in open period 11. No invoice status changes, because only a duplicate_invoice finding may void an invoice.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 1406 debits expense 5500 for 1573.46, but the invoice amount and the AP 2000 credit are 1537.46 (digits transposed). A one-sided credit of 36.00 to 5500 in open period 11 (original period 1 is closed) brings the expense to 1537.46 and balances the journal group. No invoice status change.
